messages:
maya (People Ops): Quick note — new manager (Priya Rao) starts Mon 04/08. Drafting a compact first-7-day sprint + access checklist. Will post proposed agenda below, please add missing asks or :thumbsup: if good.

sam (Hiring Manager): Thanks Maya — adding request: intro to infra/observability and a short Redwood Console demo. Can we also schedule a 30-min hiring debrief in week 1?

olivia (Engineering Manager): Agree on infra + console. Also recommend 1:1s with Eng Lead and Product Lead within first 48 hours so they can see roadmap context.

leo (IT): IT note: I'll pre-stage a laptop image and start Okta + GitHub invites tomorrow. Need laptop preference, shipping address, and any vendor VPN access (yes/no). I'll also open a ticket to add to the AD groups.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: "Manager Security Training" auto-assigns on account creation. Completion due by day 3. Link: https://training.redwood/internal/manager-security

jordan (Buddy): Happy to be the buddy — will send a quick intro DM and block a 30-min buddy sync each morning for week 1. I'll also run through culture norms and where docs live.

maya (People Ops): Proposed sprint (compact, actionable):
- Day 0 (pre-start): laptop shipped, Okta invite, GH org invite, calendar invites created, Slack DM from Buddy.
- Day 1 (orientation): 30m intro with People Ops + 1h team all-hands, 30m hiring debrief w/Sam, 1:1 with buddy.
- Day 2 (product/roadmap): product walkthrough with Product Lead, access to PRD links, key customers/context.
- Day 3 (systems + metrics): infra/observability + Redwood Console demo, access to dashboards, SLOs explained.
- Day 4 (processes): release cadence, incident playbook, oncall rotation overview (if applicable).
- Day 5 (plan & outcomes): draft 30/60/90 plan together, agree on success metrics, sync with manager.
- End of week: 60-min recap with People Ops + hiring manager, collect feedback.

Tasks (short checklist for owners):
- IT (leo): create accounts, ship hardware, grant SSO and GitHub (Action: create ticket #IT-ONB-PRIA).
- Hiring Manager (sam): schedule hiring debrief, product intro, and set 1:1 cadence.
- Buddy (jordan): send welcome DM, daily 30-min sync, run culture tour.
- People Ops (maya): calendar + docs bundle, run benefits orientation, confirm payroll + org chart.
- Security (auto): assign manager security training, MFA enforcement.

30/60/90 template (short):
```
30-day: Understand product, team, and metrics. Attend all key meetings. Draft initial 30-day observations.
60-day: Own major area, begin OKRs alignment, run first team initiative end-to-end.
90-day: Deliver measurable project (reduce latency/cost/improve onboarding), finalize 90-day roadmap with metrics.
```

sam (Hiring Manager): This looks great. One extra ask: please add a customer-shadowing slot if possible (30-60 min) — helps context.

olivia (Engineering Manager): Also flag any required compliance training for private deployments customers — if Priya will touch those accounts, schedule early.

leo (IT): Noted. I'll include VPN and HSM/KMS access requests in the ticket if the manager will be on private deployments.

maya (People Ops): Updated checklist: customer-shadowing slot added to Day 3 afternoon, compliance training flagged. I'll push calendar invites once we get confirmation on laptop/shipping from Leo.

jordan (Buddy): I'll draft a 30-min "how we ship" session and add it to Day 2.

maya (People Ops): Final asks for Sam before EOD: 1) confirm start date/time and timezone, 2) send shipping address & laptop preference to Leo, 3) confirm the primary product and customer to shadow. If anyone else has items, drop em here. :sparkles:
